meta.title: Accessibility statement
meta.description: Accessibility statement of the Ministry of Defense and the Armed Forces portal.

hero.title: Accessibility statement
hero.lead: The ministry is committed to making its portal accessible to all users.
hero.notice: This statement was drawn up in accordance with the accessibility standards in force.

declaration.title: Statement of commitment
declaration.lead: The ministry is committed to continuously improving the accessibility of its portal.

paragraphs.p1: Digital accessibility is a condition for equal access to public services. The ministry ensures that its portal can be used by everyone, including people with disabilities.
paragraphs.p2: This commitment is reflected in regular audits, the correction of non-conformities and the training of teams.

conformite.title: Compliance status
conformite.lead: The portal is assessed against the standards in force.

bullets.b1: The main pages meet the basic accessibility criteria.
bullets.b2: Corrections are made on an ongoing basis to existing content.
bullets.b3: A full audit is scheduled to confirm the level of compliance.

nonAccessibles.title: Non-accessible content
nonAccessibles.lead: Some content may present temporary access difficulties.

bullets.b1: Documents published in older formats may not be fully accessible.
bullets.b2: Some embedded applications may have shortcomings.
bullets.b3: Content in foreign languages may not have alternatives.

etablissement.title: Drawing up of this statement
etablissement.lead: This statement describes the assessment process implemented.

retour.title: Feedback and contact
retour.lead: If you encounter an accessibility problem, you can report it to us.

paragraphs.p1: You can send your comments to the relevant service through the portal's contact page.

voiesRecours.title: Remedies
voiesRecours.lead: In the event of a persistent difficulty, remedies are available.

bullets.b1: You can refer the matter to the competent mediator.
bullets.b2: You can file a complaint with the administration.
bullets.b3: You can refer the matter to the competent court.

meta.description: Personal data protection policy of the portal.

hero.title: Data protection policy
hero.lead: How the ministry processes your personal data.

responsable.title: Data controller
responsable.lead: The ministry is the controller of the data processing.

paragraphs.p1: The ministry determines the purposes and means of processing the data collected on the portal.

responsable.label: Controller
responsable.value: Ministry of Defense and the Armed Forces

adresse.label: Address
adresse.value: Ministry of Defense and the Armed Forces, Republic of Astoria

donnees.title: Data collected
donnees.lead: Only the data necessary for the purposes pursued is collected.

bullets.b1: The identification data you enter in the forms.
bullets.b2: The contact data needed to process your request.
bullets.b4: Audience measurement data, if you have consented to it.

finalites.title: Purposes and legal bases
finalites.lead: Each processing operation pursues a specific purpose and relies on a legal basis.

paragraphs.p1: The processing operations carried out serve a public-interest mission or a legal obligation of the ministry.
paragraphs.p2: Data is never used for purposes incompatible with those for which it was collected.

conservation.title: Retention period
conservation.lead: Data is kept for a limited and proportionate period.

duree.label: Period
duree.value: Period necessary for the purpose pursued

droits.title: Your rights
droits.lead: You have rights over your personal data.

bullets.b1: Right of access to your data.
bullets.b3: Right to erasure in the cases provided for by the regulations.
bullets.b5: Right to object on legitimate grounds.

cookies.title: Cookies and audience measurement
cookies.lead: The portal uses cookies to operate and to measure its audience.

paragraphs.p1: You can change your cookie choices at any time.

cookies.notice: Non-essential cookies are only set with your consent.

hero.title: Terms of use
hero.lead: The rules applicable to the use of the portal.
hero.notice: Using the portal constitutes acceptance of these terms.

objet.title: Purpose
objet.lead: These terms define the conditions for using the portal.

paragraphs.p1: The purpose of the portal is to inform the public about the ministry's action and to facilitate access to services and online procedures.
paragraphs.p2: The publisher reserves the right to amend these terms at any time.

utilisation.title: Use of the portal
utilisation.lead: Users undertake to use the portal in compliance with the regulations.

bullets.b1: Not to impair the operation or security of the portal.
bullets.b2: Not to attempt to access unauthorized data.
bullets.b3: Not to impersonate a third party.
bullets.b4: Not to publish unlawful or misleading content.

contenus.lead: The content published on the portal is protected by the applicable law.

paragraphs.p1: Unless otherwise stated, the content is made available under an open licence.
paragraphs.p2: Personal data is processed in accordance with the data protection policy.

responsabilite.title: Liability
responsabilite.lead: The ministry cannot be held liable for certain uses of the portal.

paragraphs.p1: The ministry strives to ensure the accuracy and availability of the information published, without guaranteeing the absence of errors or interruptions.
paragraphs.p2: Links to third-party sites do not engage the liability of the ministry.

liens.title: Links
liens.lead: Setting up links to the portal is governed by rules.

paragraphs.p1: Any link to the portal must comply with the conditions of use and must not mislead the public.

modification.title: Amendment of the terms
modification.lead: These terms may be amended to reflect changes to the portal.

paragraphs.p1: The version in force is the one published on the portal on the date of your visit.

modification.notice: You should check the terms of use regularly.
